neighbours.label: The indefinite 'anything' (and 'any key') after 'on' or 'press' ('click on anything else', 'press any key')
fire: The window closes if you tap on anything else on the screen.
You may ask me about anything you like.
Press any key when the menu appears.
The shop sells anything a hiker might need.
Do not click on anything inside the message.
He would give up anything for a quiet week.
Hit any key to restart the game.
She can fix almost anything with a bit of tape.
quiet: The window closes if you tap on the corner of the screen.
You may ask me about the schedule you like.
Press the green key when the menu appears.
The shop sells boots a hiker might need.
Do not click on the link inside the message.
He would give up his chair for a quiet week.
Hit the space bar to restart the game.
She can fix the sink with a bit of tape.
